Seven studios compete for Fremont's dance students. None has finished the work AI search now rewards.

We audited 7 dance and ballroom studios serving the Fremont market head to head: site quality, Google's local results, and 6 live checks across ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI. The sites range from 28 to 95. The AI engines name only four of the 7, and all two studios in Hayward and Livermore were never named once. The field averages 62 (D) on AI readiness, 7 of 7 have no FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 5 of 7 have no llms.txt file. Whichever studio closes that gap first changes the answer for everyone searching this market.

Prepared by SiteTradeIn · Market snapshot generated 14 Oct 2026 · Independent audit — not commissioned by any studio in the field · See the ranked list

About this report

This is a market-wide snapshot, not an audit of a single business. We picked one competitive local market — dance and ballroom instruction in the Fremont, CA area — and ran the same measurement against every studio that competes for it: an automated site-quality grade across seven categories, where each studio shows up in Google's local results, and 6 live checks asking three AI engines who they'd recommend for two real buyer queries. Every studio named below is graded on identical criteria, on the same day, with no advance notice.

The point isn't to single any one studio out — it's to show what an AI-search-era competitive landscape actually looks like once you measure it instead of guessing at it. If your studio is one of the 7 below, this is where you stand today.

What the field shows

  • Arthur Murray Dance Studio Hayward (95) and Arthur Murray Dance Studio Livermore (95) lead on site quality, and the field runs down to 28. One score is shared.
  • No studio earns an A for AI readiness. The field averages 62 (D) on the category that decides whether an AI engine can read, trust and quote a site; the best score in the market is 85.
  • None of the 7 studios has FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 5 have no llms.txt file — the two cheapest AI-answer signals available. No studio in the market has both.
  • Three of the 7 are franchise locations (three Arthur Murray); the rest are independent studios.
  • One site in the field still isn't served over HTTPS — a critical flag browsers show visitors before they see a single class schedule.
  • The gap between #1 and #7 is 67 points on identical criteria. Nothing in the scorecard requires a rebuild or a rebrand to close it — just the work.

Three of the 7 studios are never named on any of the 6 checks: Arthur Murray Dance Studio Hayward, Arthur Murray Dance Studio Livermore, Feel Dance Studio. For a studio not doing this work, that's the default outcome — not a penalty, just the result of nobody in that seat having claimed it yet.

What separates the winners from the rest

  • Off-site proof, not just on-site polish. AI answers draw on what other sites say about a studio, not just on its own pages, so reviews, directory listings and a complete Google profile carry real weight.
  • Being unmistakably “in Fremont.” Every AI mention went to a studio inside the city. Studios that serve Fremont from nearby towns need pages, profiles and listings that say so in the words people search.
  • A complete, specific site. The strongest sites have no missing H1s or meta descriptions, alt text on their images, and schema that describes what the studio actually is.
  • Content matched to how people actually ask. The broad question and the ballroom question pull from different result sets — a studio needs to answer both.

Methodology & notes

Field (7 studios): arthurmurraylive.com/hayward, arthurmurraylive.com/livermore, arthurmurrayfremont.com, feeldance.team, hermosuradance.com, mambogroovin.com, premierballroomstudio.com. Chosen from live Google searches on 14 Oct 2026: every adult ballroom, Latin or partner-dance studio with a working website that appeared in Google's local results for Fremont dance searches. The Bay Area is split into five pages: San Francisco, Oakland (East Bay), San Jose (South Bay), Fremont (south Alameda County and the Tri-Valley) and San Mateo (the Peninsula). Mambo Groovin' and Feel Dance each teach in two places from one website; they're rated here with their Fremont studios. Studio M, Park Avenue, We Evolve and other San Jose studios that appear in these searches are ranked on the San Jose page. Left out: Vibe at the Wall (booking page only), Salsa On Time (no website of its own), private instructors (Ballroom by Tiffany, Wedding & Salsa Dance with Lucy, Desiree May, a Dublin instructor whose site now forwards to a personal page), youth, K-pop and Bollywood studios that lead the broad answers (Tiffany's Dance Academy, Enjoy Dance Studio, Yoko's, Paradise Dance, ASI Dance Elite, Riar Academy, BollyNaach), and fitness studios (SOL Studios).

Site audit: the same SiteTradeIn engine run for every studio on 14 Oct 2026, up to six pages per site, seven categories. Franchise locations that live on a national website (Arthur Murray) share that site's robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap and templates.

AI visibility: 6 live checks — ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI, each asked “What are the best dance studios in Fremont, CA?” and “What are the best ballroom dance studios in Fremont, CA?” with a request for a top-five numbered list. Rankings are taken from each engine's own list; presence was confirmed by reading the raw response text, and every franchise mention was matched to its location. Each question was asked in a fresh session of each engine's public web app (ChatGPT and Gemini logged out, Google's AI Mode), not through a developer API.

Google: local (Places) and first-page organic results captured in a live browser session on 14 Oct 2026 for “ballroom dance lessons fremont ca”; “dance lessons fremont ca”; “salsa lessons fremont ca”; “wedding dance lessons fremont ca”; “ballroom dance lessons hayward ca”, plus the organic searches “best dance studios in fremont ca” and “ballroom dance studio fremont”. Each query named the city; results vary by searcher location and over time.

Independence. This report is a market-wide measurement, not commissioned by or customized for any single studio named in it.

Limits. AI answers and search results vary between runs and over time; these are a point-in-time sample, not a fixed ranking.
